_about: RuneScape-style skills of the fantasy world (rules: core/skill_levels.gd). xp needed to reach level L = base * (L-1)^power, cap = max_level. nodes = things in the world you work on (tree, rock, fishing spot, crop); recipes = things made at a station (fire, forge, workbench, cauldron). All numbers are placeholders for the director. gather: how close you must stand, the chance a node is used up after each item, and how much faster each tool tier above the needed one works. nodes.water: fishing spots sit on real water: fresh = ponds and lakes, salt = the sea, lava = the pools of the volcano. gather.reach_water: how far a rod casts from the bank. Names are in data/fantasy/writing/skills.txt. Each skill has an icon (a shape of data/icons.json); stations = the icon of each crafting station. VERSION 2 (sea step 3): 15 skills, every skill opens something at levels 5, 10 ... 50 (`unlocks`): kind content = the node / recipe / log ids it opens (their level must be that level; magic "slot" = one more element per cast; "later:<x>" = a sea system still to come) or kind perk = bonuses that add up per skill: speed (gathering takes that share less time), double (chance of one more of what is gathered, or made by a recipe with batch: true), keep (chance a node is not used up), save (chance a recipe or a log is not used), regrow (herbs grow back that share sooner), bonus {item, chance} (an extra find while gathering), heal (food heals more), potency (potions heal, refill and last longer), fire_time / fire_regen / fire_radius (your fires last longer, refill more mana, reach further), mana / regen / power (Magic), ship_speed / repair / cannon_reload (Sailing, with the ships of sea step 5). Rules: core/skill_perks.gd. Unlock names and lines: data/fantasy/writing/skills.txt [unlock <skill>]. Hunting: nodes with `animal` are tracks (following them takes `seconds`, then that animal is met 25-35 m on along the trail; once = used up by one go); gather.snare: a set snare catches the region's best small game you may hunt after `seconds` (less with snare_speed perks), max snares out at once, keep_snare = chance the snare comes back. Content steps may also open animals (data/fantasy/enemies.json with skill hunting). Sea step 3c: stations sawhorse (Carpentry: planks, crates, barrels) and crafting_table (Crafting: leather, cut gems, snares, and pieces for the gun side's gear: gear.json kind gunside); station site = repairs done where the broken thing stands (ladders, sea step 3d). Perk finer = chance a crafted gun-side piece comes one tier up. Sea step 3e, Archaeology: nodes with `finds` are digs (each find is picked by weight: an encrusted relic); station restore_table: restore a relic, and hand in a region's three relics for its collection (recipe `lore` = a line of data/fantasy/writing/skills.txt [lore <id>] told on completing it).
